notes.title: The release date for the Japanese live-action romance ADV game "Love Start Again
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622303/5c9a2c8e6c8123f94e3859885b51226606602614.png"][/img]This title is a live-action (FMV) romance adventure where you make choices to shape your future and advance the story while watching immersive, short drama-style videos from the protagonist's perspective. The story follows a main character who, after collapsing from overwork at an exploitative corporation, time-leaps back to his college days to reclaim a brighter future.[/p][p]In addition to classic romance archetypes like the charming junior, the reliable senior, and the childhood friend, the game also offers a modern twist: the chance to romance your favorite influencer. After your time leap, you'll find yourself entangled in the kind of dramatic romance you've always dreamed of, with dates unfolding at various real-life locations across Tokyo.[/p][p]With a total video volume equivalent to two feature films, this is a truly ambitious and lovingly crafted project.[/p][p]Don't miss this opportunity to get Love: Start Again, the live-action romance adventure from Japan that's already gaining attention on social media worldwide, at a special launch discount![/p][p]● Launch Celebration Sale[/p][p]To celebrate the game's release, we are holding a limited-time sale where you can purchase the game for 10% OFF the regular price.[/p][p]This sale is the perfect opportunity for everyone to experience the charm of this title right away—whether you've been eagerly awaiting its release or are just discovering it for the first time.[/p]
